{"metadata":{"description":"中文 · GitHub","id":"gh:1369155407","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-fetch-moli","slug":"GreyRaphael/dsh-web-fetch-moli","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"# dsh-web-fetch-moli"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"中文 · GitHub"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin providing a **Moli** backend for the `web_fetch` tool. Built on Moli"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" (an ultra-lightweight Rust headless browser), it renders dynamic micro-frontends, single-page appli"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"cations (SPAs), and static sites in a memory footprint an order of magnitude below a full Chromium/P"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"laywright stack, denoises pages via **LinkeDOM + Readability + mdream**, and returns clean, LLM-opti"},{"id":"p3s5","text":"mized GitHub Flavored Markdown."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Key Highlights"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **Lightweight Footprint** — A local daemon costs single-digit MB at rest and tens of MB while rend"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ering (measured below), so high concurrency stays viable on resource-constrained servers. See Measur"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ed footprint for the numbers and their conditions.
- **Enterprise Micro-Frontend & Dynamic SPA Compa"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"tibility** — Bypasses Content Security Policy (`Page.setBypassCSP`), bypasses Service Worker caching"},{"id":"p5s5","text":", and can optionally ignore TLS certificate errors (`ignoreCertificateErrors`, off by default). Driv"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"es native Moli layout tree computation via CDP Micro-Clip layout materialization (`Page.captureScree"},{"id":"p5s7","text":"nshot` 1x1 micro-viewport) and triggers W3C standard `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })` without "},{"id":"p5s8","text":"any user-script monkey-patching, cleanly rendering complex micro-frontends (Alibaba Alfa, qiankun, s"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"ingle-spa) that require full dynamic-script execution.
- **Two Flexible Backends**:
- `local` *(defa"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"ult)*: Automatically manages a local `moli serve` daemon over CDP, providing full SPA and micro-fron"},{"id":"p5s11","text":"tend execution.
- `cdp`: Connects to an existing remote Moli or Chromium CDP service over Chrome Dev"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"Tools Protocol.
- **High-Performance Two-Stage Denoise Pipeline** — LinkeDOM + Mozilla Readability e"},{"id":"p5s13","text":"xtracts primary content and eliminates noise (ads, nav bars, footers, forms), followed by mdream (Ru"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"st native with pure JS fallback) for high-fidelity, LLM-optimized Markdown conversion. Inline base64"},{"id":"p5s15","text":" images are elided to compact size placeholders.
- **Cloudflare Challenge Resilience** — Detects `cf"},{"id":"p5s16","text":"-mitigated: challenge` interstitials and waits in the same page/context for natural clearance withou"},{"id":"p5s17","text":"t artificial bot behavior."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Measured footprint"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Moli is a single Rust process (no separate browser + driver + renderer tree), so its resident set st"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ays far below a
full Chromium stack. The plugin ships **no benchmark harness** — the numbers below a"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"re one measurement on one machine,
recorded here so the claim is reproducible rather than asserted. "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"Treat them as an order of magnitude, not a guarantee."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Conditions: Moli `1.1.9`, Linux x86_64, one daemon started with `moli serve`, `VmHWM` (peak resident"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" set) summed over
all `moli` processes from `/proc/<pid>/status`, 5s settle after each `Page.navigat"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"e`, single tab, no concurrency."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| State | Peak RSS (`VmHWM`) |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Daemon started, no page loaded | 13.2 MB |
| After one light static page (`example.com`) | 55.9 MB"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" |
| After one heavy article page (Wikipedia, long article + assets) | 99.6 MB |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Two things a single headline number would hide: the resting cost is small, but **a heavy page can pu"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"sh one daemon to
roughly 100 MB**, and the process does not shrink back after the page is closed (th"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"e high-water mark stays). Budget per
concurrent fetch accordingly rather than multiplying one number"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" by your concurrency."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Comparison with other engines is deliberately qualitative here: this repository contains no measurem"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ents of Chromium,
Lightpanda, or Obscura, and this project has not run their test suites, so no per-"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"product figures or failure claims are
made. What can be stated from this repository's own code and t"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"ests: the plugin drives Moli over CDP, bypasses CSP for
dynamic script loading, and materializes lay"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"out via Micro-Clip screenshots so `IntersectionObserver` sentinels fire."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- DeepSeek Harness (`dsh web`) ≥ `0.2.1-rc.3`, Node.js ≥ 22 (the plugin drives CDP over the native g"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"lobal `WebSocket`, which Node 20 does not provide).
- **Zero manual setup**: the plugin features **a"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"utomatic download on first use**. If no `moli` binary is detected, it downloads and unpacks the late"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"st release binary matching your OS and architecture (Linux, macOS, Windows x86_64 / arm64) into `~/."},{"id":"p16s5","text":"cache/moli`.
- Existing installations are detected in this order: the `moliPath` setting → the `MOLI"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"_PATH` environment variable → `~/.cache/moli/moli` → `moli` on `$PATH`. There is **no scan of `~/.lo"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"cal/bin`**; if you install Moli there, either put it on `$PATH` or set `moliPath`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Manual installation (optional). The release archive unpacks into a versioned directory
(`moli-v1.1.9"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu/`), so `--strip-components=1` is required to land the binary at a predicta"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"nknown-linux-gnu/`), so `--strip-components=1` is required to land the binary at a predictable path:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"That places the binary at `~/.local/bin/moli`, which is **not** a default search location for this p"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lugin — export it on
`PATH` (most distributions already include `~/.local/bin` there) or point the `"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"moliPath` setting at it. On Windows the
asset is a `.zip` whose archive members sit under the same v"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ersioned directory; extract it and point `moliPath` at the
resulting `moli.exe`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"> **npm status:** `dsh-web-fetch-moli` is **not yet on the npm registry**
> (`https://registry.npmjs"},{"id":"p22s2","text":".org/dsh-web-fetch-moli` returns 404 as of 0.8.0), so the bare-name form will fail today.
> Use the "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"`github:` form above. `CONTRIBUTING.md` states how an npm release is produced."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"After adding, restart `dsh web` to load the plugin."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Every option is a **volatile field of this row's Config**: since DSH 0.1.7 the settings domain serve"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"s the form from the profile entry itself, so a save applies live — no restart and no plugin remount."},{"id":"p25s3","text":" Open *dsh-web-fetch-moli* on the DSH Plugins page to edit it:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Field | Default | Description |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| `backend` | `local` | `local` (managed Moli CDP daemon) or `cdp` (remote CDP endpoint). |
| `moliP"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ath` | *(auto)* | Path to `moli` binary. Blank = discover via `MOLI_PATH`, `~/.cache/moli`, then `$P"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ATH`. |
| `cdpEndpoint` | `127.0.0.1:9222` | Remote CDP endpoint (`host:port` or URL, used in `cdp` "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"mode). |
| `shareBrowserContext` | `true` | Preserves cookies and localStorage across fetches in `cd"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"p` mode. Unchecked (and always in `local` mode): fresh isolated context per fetch. |
| `bypassCsp` |"},{"id":"p27s6","text":" `true` | Bypasses Content Security Policy via CDP `Page.setBypassCSP`, unlocking micro-frontend dyn"},{"id":"p27s7","text":"amic script loading. |
